name: Venomancer: Fury of Anub'Rekhan raises max Energy in Spider Form and max Rage in Beetle Form (#7525)
contract: #7525: Fury of Anub'Rekhan 800894 (CharacterAdvancement 6098) reads 'Increases your maximum mana, Energy, and Rage by 10%.' It has three SPELL_AURA_MOD_INCREASE_ENERGY_PERCENT (132) effects, misc 0/1/3, each +10. Spider Form 800841 switches the Venomancer to Energy and Beetle Form 803183 to Rage; Unit::setPowerType resets the max power to GetCreatePowers, which dropped the talent's TOTAL_PCT modifier. Expected: max Energy 100 * 1.10 = 110 in Spider Form and max Rage 1000 * 1.10 = 1100 in Beetle Form, each read after the form is active.
